label: For any being g: if Jesus holds a mandate from g, founded the Catholic Church, and the Catholic…
paraphrase: For any being g: if Jesus holds a mandate from g, founded the Catholic Church, and the Catholic Church is a visible society with an authority structure, then the message rival STMT-JESUS-MANDATE-COVERS-ONLY-MESSAGE is false: it is not the case that, for every being g' from which Jesus holds a mandate and every society c, Jesus did not found c in the exercise of that mandate. This is a negation of the rival only, not a positive existence statement (no witness society is produced), and it does not say that the Catholic Church is founded in the mandate. It does not assert that Jesus holds a mandate or founded the Catholic Church.
